results.title: 9 Best Flipboard Alternatives in 2026 Compared | Blog | Readless
results.content:
## 1. Feedly: organize a chosen source collection

Feedly fits readers who want to follow publications in a reader rather than rely mainly on magazine-style discovery. Its official plan guide separates Free, Pro, Pro+ and Enterprise. Pro+ includes AI Feeds and RSS Builder. Check the current pricing comparison for newsletter intake, source limits, AI eligibility and renewal billing; we have not verified a current numeric offer for this revision. See our Feedly pricing guide for the questions to compare.

## 2. Inoreader: RSS with paid newsletter intake [...] ## Frequently asked questions

Q.01#

### What is the best Flipboard alternative?

Feedly or Inoreader fit chosen-source reading; Ground News fits coverage comparison; Apple News, Google News and SmartNews fit discovery. Particle adds grouped AI summaries, NewsBlur adds RSS training and self-hosting, and Readless fits scheduled summaries. Choose by the task you need to replace.

Q.02#

### Is there a free Flipboard alternative for newsletters?

A free RSS plan is not necessarily a free newsletter inbox. Inoreader allows 150 RSS feeds on Free, while its 20 newsletter feeds require Pro. Check newsletter intake separately from RSS capacity in any competing offer.

Q.03#

### Will switching remove all advertising? [...] ## 7. NewsBlur: trainable RSS and a self-hosted option

NewsBlur lists 64 sites on Free and 1,024 on Premium at $36/year. Premium Archive costs $99/year and adds story clustering, Ask AI and daily briefings. These features do not all belong to the free reader. Its open-source code also supports self-hosting, which involves your own hosting and maintenance costs. This is a useful option for readers who want source selection and training controls rather than a magazine feed.

## 8. Particle: grouped stories and AI summaries
